# NR Validation in Entities Sandbox

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Melissa** (3/5/2026):

In the upcoming release (target Monday March 9th), name request validation will be enabled. Please ensure you use a valid NR number when submitting a filing (named). To create a new name request, visit [https://developer.connect.gov.bc.ca/en-CA/products/namex/overview](https://developer.connect.gov.bc.ca/en-CA/products/namex/overview "https://developer.connect.gov.bc.ca/en-ca/products/namex/overview").
